_comment: Banks of heavy fog that roll over the Age and lift again . It means the
phenomenon outright, as `meteors` does, and is told apart from `smothered`, which is a haze that never lifts.
The frequency words thicken it as they thicken a storm: `teeming fog` lies over the Age most of the time.
**One aspect, and the climate is not touched**, as `meteors` keeps the sky alone: a word reaching one part
of the world closes its own clause (`age fog`), and a second part would need an aiming page after it.
